96fb5cfccc089f9db6f13f7c322ed9e18dd66fc7.summary: Mandiant's M-Trends 2026 overview (published 2026-03-23) draws on over 500,000 hours of 2025 incident investigations. It reports exploits as the top initial access vector (32%), rising voice phishing (11%), and a 14-day global median dwell time. Access handed from initial access partners to ransomware groups now takes 22 seconds. It highlights edge-device espionage (UNC6201, UNC5807), the BRICKSTORM backdoor, ransomware that destroys recovery capability, and malware that queries AI tools.
